topic: Web Development with Flask and REST APIs
learningObjectives: Explain the structure of a basic Flask web application.
Create routes that handle HTTP requests and return responses.
Design a simple REST API using Flask.

activities.title: Flask Architecture
activities.instruction: Explore the components of a Flask application.

content.concept: Flask applications connect routes, request handling, application logic, and responses.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Route Anatomy
activities.instruction: Identify the parts of a Flask route.

content.concept: A Flask route maps an HTTP URL and method to a Python function that handles the request.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: REST Method Match
activities.instruction: Match HTTP methods to API operations.

content.concept: REST APIs commonly use GET, POST, PUT or PATCH, and DELETE for resource operations.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: API Builder
activities.instruction: Build a simple Flask REST endpoint.

content.concept: A REST endpoint accepts a request, performs application logic, and returns structured data such as JSON.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
